title: Extract Frames
cap_description: Decode a video and emit each frame as a PNG image
documentation:
## Purpose

Generic video frame extractor that accepts any supported video container and produces PNG images. This is the umbrella cap; format-specific variants (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM) provide more precise media type matching in the cap fabric so the planner can route correctly.

## Inputs

- A video file (any supported container — MP4/MOV/MKV/WebM).
- An optional target frame rate (default: every frame).

## Outputs

A sequence of PNG images, one per emitted frame.

## Notes

- For typed pipelines, prefer the format-specific variants ([MP4](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:extract-frames;in="media:mp4;video";out="media:image;png"), [MOV](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:extract-frames;in="media:mov;video";out="media:image;png"), [MKV](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:extract-frames;in="media:mkv;video";out="media:image;png"), [WebM](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:extract-frames;in="media:webm;video";out="media:image;png")) so the planner can route correctly.
- This umbrella variant is useful when the input video format is not known at pipeline design time.

args.arg_description: Path to the video file to process
Target frames per second. Omit to emit every decoded frame.

output.output_description: PNG images, one per emitted frame
